- **p5.js 1.11.11** (`p5.min.js`) is distributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1. The license text is in `P5-LICENSE.txt`. Project: https://p5js.org/
- **MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.32** (`mediapipe/vision_bundle.mjs` and `mediapipe/wasm/`) is identified as Apache-2.0 in its npm package metadata. License: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0. Project: https://developers.google.com/mediapipe

These browser runtime assets are included to make Genereti classroom demos work offline. Their licenses are separate from the Genereti project code and from downloaded AI models.

- **Excalidraw 0.18.1** (`excalidraw/`) is MIT. The included license is `excalidraw/LICENSE-EXCALIDRAW.txt`. Source: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw. The local bundle also includes React/React DOM 18.3.1 (MIT) and transitive browser dependencies; esbuild retains their inline notices in the generated `.LEGAL.txt` files. Font files are copied unchanged from Excalidraw's npm distribution; upstream font metadata and attribution remain embedded in those files.
